scope: A4 routing and SLO policy audit before W7900 measurement
objective: Select a low-occupancy and delayed-arrival routing policy only when it improves exact generated-token SLO-goodput without materially regressing C1 or violating exact state, KV, lifecycle, cancellation, backpressure, or overload gates.

hardware.peer_gpu1_activity: allowed only when independently pinned and recorded as non-target contention

audit_findings.batch_window_interpretation: The production gate's 100 ms argparse default is a harness default, not the hipEngine package default. Package-default rows must omit both CLI and environment overrides and must resolve to 0 ms. An explicit 0 ms row is an equivalence control; 5 ms and 100 ms are opt-in candidates and may not be relabeled as package defaults.

gfx1151_transfer_evidence.candidate_to_transfer_not_assume: fair:256 with two-chunk bounded cold-cohort admission
gfx1151_transfer_evidence.non_transfer_rule: gfx1151 timings and selection do not select a gfx1100 default; W7900 must independently pass the complete funnel

audit_findings.collector_limit: scripts/agentic_coding_live.py releases simultaneous deterministic tool waves but does not implement delayed mixed arrivals or live-exact ITL. A4 SLO selection therefore uses response-owned IDs and live_exact token events from the production/server routing collectors; agentic tool rows remain the exact tool-envelope and buffered tool-ready guard.

stage_0_default_resolution.gate: Both rows must expose the expected scheduler/window metadata and produce exact identical response-owned C1 IDs with zero final ownership. This is a correctness equivalence check, not a speed comparison.

workload.generated_token_id_source: resident runner reclaim matched to independent C1 sessions

candidates.provenance: independent gfx1100 transfer candidate from retained gfx1151 policy
bounded positive-window plus gfx1151 transfer candidate
historical production-gate window; diagnostic unless it passes the C1 latency guard

stage_1_mixed_arrival_screen.measurement_order: Run three fresh or independently reset balanced sweeps. Rotate candidate order by one third of the list per sweep. Do not select from a single unbalanced pass.
stage_1_mixed_arrival_screen.primary_metric: exact generated-token SLO-goodput over the delayed mixed-arrival shape
stage_1_mixed_arrival_screen.early_rejection: Reject any candidate immediately on generated-ID/state/KV/lifecycle drift, target-GPU contention, invalid live_exact timing, failed SLO, or greater than 5% C1 active-SSE or tool-ready regression. Missing timing is not inferred.

stage_2_occupancy_matrix.eligible_rows: control plus every stage-1 candidate that improves median mixed SLO-goodput and passes all gates
required_metrics: ITL p50/p95/p99 only from live_exact one-token events
physical c1/c2/c4/c8 step counts and occupancy transitions
stage_2_occupancy_matrix.exactness: Every row and delayed survivor must match its independent C1 generated-ID trajectory; physical width changes must preserve stable request identity, Conv/GDN state, live KV, and reclaim ownership.

stage_3_agentic_and_safety_guards.agentic_guard: Run small_repo, growing_history, and medium_repo deterministic strict-tool waves for the selected candidate and paired package control. Require exact response-owned A1 IDs, valid strict tool envelopes, active-SSE goodput, buffered tool-ready p50/p95/p99, and zero final ownership. Withhold ITL because public tool streams are buffered_public.
stage_3_agentic_and_safety_guards.safety_requirements: Cancelled/disconnected/timed-out rows must not corrupt exact survivors; stream queues stay bounded; overload reports exact accepted and 429 engine_busy counts; final active/pending/session/KV/cache/graph/workspace/producer ownership is zero.

acceptance_policy.selection: Choose the highest median exact SLO-goodput candidate only among complete passing rows. A candidate must improve the primary metric over pd256_b1_w0_control, keep C1 active-SSE and buffered tool-ready within 5%, pass the occupancy and delayed-admission exactness gates, and pass agentic and safety guards.
acceptance_policy.default_change: No runtime default changes during measurement. Promotion, if any, is a separate implementation task and requires the final A4 decision artifact.
acceptance_policy.neutral_or_failed_result: Retain gfx1100 protect_decode:256/burst1 with zero package batch window and record all candidates as rejected or neutral; do not infer unmeasured rows.
acceptance_policy.no_benchmark_gaming: Do not alter prompts, token IDs, arrival order, thresholds, seeds, model routes, or candidate membership after observing W7900 results.

planned_commands.routing_matrix: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/agentic-w7900-hipcc-version.txt uv run python scripts/server_f1_concurrency_bench.py --engine hipengine --model /models/gguf/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf --backend hip_gfx1100 --quant gguf_q4_k_m --hipengine-kv-storage bf16 --hipengine-route-expectation native --concurrencies 1,2,4,8 --prompt-length 512 --decode-tokens 128 --ctx-per-seq 1024 --warmup-runs 1 --measured-runs 3 --streaming-primary --stream-warmup-runs 1 --stream-measured-runs 3 --live-concurrency 8 --live-join-after-tokens 8 --compiler-version-file /tmp/agentic-w7900-hipcc-version.txt --memory-domain vram --drm-card-index 0 --json <candidate-json>
planned_commands.mixed_slo: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/agentic-w7900-hipcc-version.txt uv run python scripts/gguf_production_load_gate.py --model /models/gguf/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf --backend hip_gfx1100 --quant gguf_q4_k_m --workloads continuous_fixed --max-active-requests 8 --batch-window-ms <0|5|100> --fixed-rate-per-second 2 --slo-queue-p99-seconds 10 --slo-ttft-p95-seconds 10 --slo-itl-p99-seconds 0.5 --slo-end-to-end-p95-seconds 30 --compiler-version-file /tmp/agentic-w7900-hipcc-version.txt --require-cached-build --json <candidate-json>
planned_commands.agentic_guard: Use scripts/agentic_coding_live.py against a real localhost server with cache off, native sampler off, the retained exact A1 control, one untimed warmup, and three balanced measured runs per family.

limitations: The predeclaration contains no GPU timings and makes no performance claim.
The existing production-load collector is synthetic token-ID/SLO coverage, not a strict-tool workload; the final selection therefore requires the separate frozen agentic tool-envelope guard.
The package-default and explicit-zero batch-window controls resolve to the same numeric policy in this revision; their only valid purpose is default-resolution equivalence, not a claimed A/B speedup.
A task-specific benchmark driver may orchestrate the declared candidates, but it may not change the frozen candidate set, shapes, metrics, gates, or selection rule.
